newsitem.title: USA: Tigera Group says plans reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Tigera Group says plans reverse split.

text.p: Tigera Group Inc said on Monday it would seek a one-for-four reverse stock split that would reduce its outstanding shares to 5.6 million from 22.3 million.
The company said it has filed a draft proxy with the Securities and Exchange Commission to schedule a shareholder meeting on November 19 in New York to approve this and other proposals.
Besides the reverse split, the company plans to change its name to Connectivity Technologies Inc and apply for listing on Nasdaq.

Tigera, which bought privately-held Connectivity Products Inc in May, distributes and manufactures wire and cable products for security and sound systems, factory automation systems and traffic control systems.
